title: Why You Feel a Sudden Chill, Even When It's Warm
hook: You feel a sudden chill, a shiver, even a "someone walked over your grave" sensation.

narration.text: You feel a sudden chill, a shiver, even a "someone walked over your grave" sensation.
This is often your body's clever way of regulating its temperature.
Small muscles attached to your hair follicles contract rapidly.
This creates tiny bumps and generates a small amount of heat.
It can happen when the air cools slightly, or even with strong emotions.
So, it is usually just your internal thermostat at work.
Tell us in the comments if this explanation surprised you, and follow for more insights into your amazing body.

description: Ever wonder why you suddenly feel a chill even when the room temperature seems fine? This sensation, often described as 'someone walking over your grave,' is actually a common bodily response.
topic: Why you might feel a sudden chill or 'someone walking over your grave' sensation. This is often a body temperature regulation response.
